info.name: X-Files
info.summary: Trust no one — a photo vault for your most sensitive images.
info.description:
X-Files is a photo vault that protects your most sensitive images with an independent password, completely isolated from Files, Photos, Memories, WebDAV, and Search.
**Features:** - Password-protected vault (independent from Nextcloud login) - Real file isolation via AppData (invisible to other apps) - Auto-lock after configurable timeout - Brute-force protection on unlock attempts - Thumbnail gallery when unlocked - Recovery key for password reset - Download recovery key as formatted text file - Change password and settings from within the vault - Auto-lock when browser tab is closed
**Security:** - Images stored in AppData (not in user filesystem) - Other apps (Files, Photos, Memories) cannot see vault content - WebDAV and desktop/mobile clients cannot access vault images - Vault password hashed with Argon2id - Session-based unlock with configurable timeout - Brute-force and rate-limit protection
Lock your secrets. Trust no one.
info.author: Luis Carmo
